oil.when: 2012–2016 (MENU button, thumbwheel and SET/CLR on the turn signal lever)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on without starting the engine.
Press MENU and roll the thumbwheel until Remaining Oil Life shows.
Press SET/CLR while oil life is showing. A chime sounds and the reading goes back to 100%.
oil.note: Checked in the 2012 Getting to Know Your Sonic guide and the 2016 owner's manual.

steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the Tire and Loading Information label below the driver's door latch.
There is no reset button. The low tire pressure light stays on until the pressure is corrected, then goes off on its own after a short drive.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2012 Getting to Know Your Sonic guide and the 2016 owner's manual. If the light comes on only on cold mornings and goes off as you drive, a tire is getting low.
